paite: Huan, kum sawm leh kum li a bei nungin Tita mahleng pi samin, Barnaba toh Jerusalem khuaah ka vahohtou nawna.
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

paite: Huan, theihsakna jiakin ka vahoh toua, Jentelte laka tanchin hoih ka tangkoupih tuh amau ka vahilha; himahleh mi lian deuhte tuh a tuamin ka hilha; huchilouin jaw a thawnin ka tai kha dinga, ahihkeileh taithawnta kana hi kha dinga.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

paite: Himahleh, Tita ka kianga om leng Grik mi himahleh zeksumsak teiteiin a om kei hi.
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

paite: Huai tuh unau taklou, a guka piluta omte, sala honlak theihna ding ua Kris Jesu-a noplenna i neih uh enkhe dinga honglutte jiakin a hi-
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;

paite: Himahleh tanchinhoih thutak tuh noua dinga bittaka kep a hihtheihna dingin, amau kiangah mitphiat kal lel leng ka kipe himhim kei uhi.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

paite: Huan, hihna deuh min nei mahmahte (bangchibang hihna nei mah le uh kei adingin a lamdanna om kei; Pathianin kuamah a khentuam kei) -huai min nei mahmahten bangmah honbehlap kei uh.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important (whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man)—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

paite: Huchihnaksangin, zeksumte kianga tanchinhoih Peter kianga kepsaka a om bangin zeksumlouhte kianga tanchinhoih kei kiangah kepsakin a om chih a theih takun,
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcision, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcision

paite: (Zeksumte sawltak hi dinga Petera sempa mahin Jentelte sawltak hi dingin kei ah a sem ngala)
english: (for he who appointed Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision appointed me also to the Gentiles);

paite: Huan, hehpihna kei kianga piaka om a muh takun, Jakob te, Kifa te, Johan te, khuam muanhuai hi-a minneiten, amau bel zeksumte kianga hoh dinga, kou Jentelte kianga hoh dingin, kei leh Barnaba tuh kithuahna khut taklam honpe zota uhi.
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

paite: Gentheite ka theihgige lel uh a deih ua, huai tak tuh hih ka tum chiltel him ahi.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

paite: Huan Kifa tuh Antiok khuaa a hongpai laiin demhuai mahmaha a om jiakin a maitang ngeiah ka kalha.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

paite: Mi kuate hiam Jakob kianga kipana a hongpai ma un amah tuh Jentelte kiangah an a, ne jel hi; himahleh a hongtun tak un zeksumte a kihtak jiakin pang nawnta louin a kihihtuamta ngala.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

paite: Juda dangte leng a lepchiah chiat sam ua, huchiin Barnaba hilhial leng a lepchiahna ua pimangin a omzou hial ahi.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

paite: Himahleh, tanchin hoih thutak bangin a om gina kei uh chih ka theihin, Kifa kiangah, a vek ua maah, Nang Juda mi na hi ngala, Judate om banga omlou in, Jentelte om banga na om jawk leh, bangchidanin ahia Jentelte Judate om banga na om sak teitei nak? ka chi hi.
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

paite: Ei jaw Jentel mi khialte hi louin, Juda mi hima piang i hi ua-
english: “We, being Jews by nature, and not Gentile sinners,

paite: Himahleh, dan thilhihte jiakin mi siamtangin a om kei hi, Jesu Kris gin jiak kia in siamtangin om jaw uh chih i thei ngala-en leng dan thilhih jiak hi louin, Kris ginna jiaka siamtanga i om theihna dingin, Kris Jesu tuh i ging ahi; dan thilhihte jiakin mihing himhim siamtanga om lou ding uh ahi ngala.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

paite: Ahihleh Krisa simatanga om tum kawmpia eite mikhialte i nahih nak leh, Kris tuh khelhna omsakpa hita ve maw le'! Hilou hial.
english: But if, while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

paite: Ka thil hihsiatte ka lam nawn jel injaw, talekpa ka hi chih ka kitheisak phet ahi ding hi.
english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

paite: Pathian lama dia ka honghin theihna dingin, kei jaw dan jiakin dan lamah ka si khinta ngala.
english: For I, through the law, died to the law, that I might live to God.

paite: Kris toh kilhdenin ka omta; himahleh ka hing ahi; keimah pen ka hita keia, Kris tuh keimah ah a hing ahi jaw; huan, tua saa ka hin bel ginnaa hing ka hi-Pathian Tapa, a honita ka sika kipepa, ginna ah.Pathian hehpihna tuh bangmah louin ka bawl kei, dan jiaka diktatna a om ngal injaw Kris a thawna si ahi ding hi.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ living in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.

paite: Pathian hehpihna tuh bangmah louin ka bawl kei, dan jiaka diktatna a om ngal injaw Kris a thawna si ahi ding hi.
english: I don’t make void the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
